description:
Port-map §7. The contract for all UI pieces.

- OctoPi.Tui.Component @behaviour:
    @callback render(state :: struct(), width :: pos_integer()) ::
              [Line.t()]
    @callback handle_key(state, %Key{}) :: state | {state, [Event.t()]}
- Struct-state, immutable. No lifecycle hooks in MVP (mount/unmount
  defer to 4.1).

Three starter components:
- OctoPi.Tui.Components.Text — wraps a pre-formatted string into
  width, preserves ANSI styling. Pure render/2.
- OctoPi.Tui.Components.SelectList — multi-column list with
  alignment, fuzzy-filter hook, custom truncation callback.
  Tests mirror §14.4 (select-list.test.ts, 116 lines).
- OctoPi.Tui.Components.Input — single-line value + cursor +
  focused; handle_key dispatched via multi-head pattern match on
  the key binary ("\r", "\e[D", "\e[C", fallback). Kill ring +
  undo are deferred to the Editor (.8).

TDD:
- Text: wraps + truncates at width, preserves ANSI codes.
- SelectList: alignment across items, ellipsis with alignment
  preserved, fuzzy-filter scoring (port fuzzy.test.ts §14.4).
- Input: Enter submits, left/right moves cursor, chars append at
  cursor.

Depends on .1.
title: Component behaviour + Text/SelectList/Input minimal
